title: Designing Porous Silicon Films as Carriers of Nerve Growth Factor
protocol: Cut a Si wafer into 1.5 cm × 1.5 cm samples using a diamond-tipped pen.
Oxidize the Si samples in a tube furnace at 400 °C for 2 h in ambient air.
Immerse the Si samples in a solution of aqueous hydrofluoric acid (HF), ddH2O, and ethanol (1:1:3 v/v/v) for 5 min.
Rinse the samples with ethanol three times.
Dry the samples under a nitrogen stream.
Mount the Si sample in a polytetrafluoroethylene etching cell using an aluminum foil back-contact and a platinum coil counter electrode.
Etch a sacrificial layer in a 3:1 (v/v) solution of aqueous HF and ethanol for 30 s at a constant current density of 250 mA/cm².
Rinse the surface of the resulting PSi film with ethanol three times.
Dry the PSi film under a nitrogen stream.
Dissolve the freshly-etched porous layer in an aqueous NaOH solution (0.1 M) for 2 min.
Rinse with ethanol three times.
Dry under a nitrogen stream.
Immerse the sample in a solution of aqueous HF (48%), ddH2O, and ethanol (99.9%) (1:1:3 v/v) for 2 min.
Rinse the sample with ethanol three times.
Dry the sample under a nitrogen stream.
Electrochemically etch the Si sample in a 3:1 (v/v) solution of aqueous HF and ethanol (99.9%) for 20 s at a constant current density of 250 mA/cm².
Rinse the surface of the resulting PSi film with ethanol three times.
Dry the PSi film under a nitrogen stream.
Thermally oxidize the freshly-etched PSi samples in a tube furnace at 800 °C for 1 h in ambient air (heating rate: 25 °C/min, natural cooling).
Spin-coat the PSiO₂ samples with a positive thick photoresist at 4,000 rpm for 1 min.
Bake the coated samples at 90 °C for 2 min (heating rate: 5 °C/min, natural cooling).
Dice the PSiO₂ samples into 8 mm × 8 mm samples using a dicing saw.
Soak the diced samples in acetone for 3 h to remove the photoresist.
Thoroughly rinse the samples with ethanol.
Dry the samples under a nitrogen stream.
Dissolve 20 µg of murine β-NGF in 400 µL of 1:1 (v/v) solution of 0.01 M phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) and ddH₂O to prepare the NGF loading solution.
Add 52 µL of the loading solution on top of the PSiO₂ sample.
Incubate for 2 h at RT in a capped dish with high humidity to prevent drying up of the solution during incubation.
Add 100 μL of 0.5 µg/mL capture antibody (rabbit anti-hβ-NGF) to each well of the ELISA plate.
Seal and incubate the plate overnight at room temperature.
Aspirate the wells to remove liquid.
Wash the plate four times using 300 μL of wash buffer per well.
Invert the plate to remove residual buffer and blot on a paper towel.
Add 300 µL of block buffer (1% bovine serum albumin in PBS) to each well.
Incubate for at least 1 h at room temperature.
Aspirate and wash the plate four times as described previously.
Dilute NGF loading solution to 1 ng/mL in diluent.
Perform 2-fold serial dilutions from 1 ng/mL to zero to obtain calibration curve samples.
Dilute the NGF loading solution (from step 2.1) and collected post-loading solution in diluent 1:100,000 and 1:10,000 respectively.
Add 100 µL of diluted samples and calibration curve samples to each well in triplicate.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 h.
Aspirate and wash the plate four times as described previously.
Add 100 µL of 1 µg/mL detection antibody (biotinylated rabbit anti-hβ-NGF) to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 hours.
Aspirate and wash the plate four times as described in step 3.2.
Dilute Avidin-Horseradish Peroxidase (HRP) 1:2,000 in diluent.
Add 100 µL of diluted Avidin-HRP to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Aspirate and wash the plate four times as described in step 3.2.
Add 100 µL of substrate solution to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 25 minutes for color development.
Measure the absorbance at 405 nm with wavelength correction set at 650 nm using a microplate reader.
Determine NGF concentration in both the loading solution and the collected post-loading solution based on the calibration curve.
Calculate NGF mass loaded within PSiO2 carrier by subtracting NGF mass in the collected post-loading solution from the NGF mass in loading solution.
Incubate the NGF-loaded PSiO2 carriers in 2 mL of 0.01 M PBS containing 1% (w/v) BSA and 0.02% (w/v) sodium azide at 37 °C under orbital agitation of 100 rpm.
Every 2 days, collect the solution and replace it with 2 mL of fresh PBS.
Freeze the collected release samples in liquid nitrogen.
Store the frozen samples at -20 °C for further analyses.
Dilute 1 mL of release samples 1:10 in release buffer (0.01 M PBS containing 1% (w/v) BSA and 0.02% (w/v) sodium azide) for a total volume of 10 mL.
Monitor Si atomic emission peaks at 212.4, 251.6, and 288.2 nm for the diluted samples.
Determine Si concentration in the samples based on a calibration curve.
Express Si content at each time point as a percentage of the total Si content of the carriers.
Prepare the basic growth medium by adding 10% horse serum, 5% fetal bovine serum, 1% L-glutamine, 1% penicillin streptomycin, and 0.2% amphotericin to RPMI medium.
Prepare differentiation medium by adding 1% horse serum, 1% L-glutamine, 1% penicillin streptomycin, and 0.2% amphotericin to RPMI medium.
Grow cell suspension (10^6 cells) in a 75 cm² culture flask with 10 mL of basic growth medium for 8 days; every 2 days add 10 mL of basic growth medium to the flask.
Transfer the cell suspension to a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells for 8 min at 200 x g and room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in 5 mL of fresh basic growth medium and re-centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 200 x g and room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 3 mL of basic growth medium.
Aspirate the cells ten times using a 23 G syringe to separate cell clusters.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer cell counter.
Seed 104 cells/cm2 working area on collagen type I coated plates in the presence of differentiation medium.
After 24 hours, add fresh murine β-NGF (50 ng/mL) or NGF-loaded PSiO2 carrier per plate.
Renew the differentiation medium every 2 days.
Add 10% (v/v) of the viability indicator solution at representative time points.
Incubate for 5 h at 37 °C.
Measure the absorbance at 490 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Douse mice with 70% ethanol and make an incision to remove the skin.
Cut the base of the skull and abdominal wall muscles till the spinal cord is exposed.
Remove the spinal column by making a cut at the level of the femurs and clean the surrounding tissues.
Cut the column into three pieces.
Then cut each piece in the midline to generate two halves and peel out the spinal cord.
Under the binocular, extract all DRG ganglia and immerse them in cold Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS).
Clean the surrounding connective tissues by pining the DRGs on a petri dish.
Gently remove residual meninges under the binocular.
Incubate DRG cells for 20 min in 1,000 U of papain.
Centrifuge the cells for 4 min at 400 x g.
Discard the supernatant and keep the cell pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in a 10 mg/mL collagenase and 12 mg/mL dispase-II solution.
Incubate the resuspended cells for 20 min at 37 °C.
Centrifuge the cells for 2 min at 400 x g.
Discard the supernatant and keep the cell pellet.
Triturate the cell pellet in 1 mL of HBSS, 10 mM glucose, and 5 mM HEPES (pH 7.35).
Gently add the dissociated cells to L-15 medium containing 20% silica-based colloidal medium for density gradient centrifugation.
Centrifuge for 8 min at 1,000 x g.
Aspirate the supernatant and keep the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL of F-12 medium.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 1,000 x g.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of F-12 medium.
Count the cells and seed 2 × 10^4 cells on poly-L-lysine and laminin-coated glass bottom 35 mm culture dishes.
Seed the cells initially in a small volume of medium (150-200 µL).
Incubate the seeded cells for 2 h at 37 °C.
Add medium to reach a final volume of 2 mL per plate.
Gently add NGF-loaded PSiO2 carrier or fresh murine β-NGF (50 ng/mL) per plate.
Incubate the NGF-loaded PSiO2 carriers in 2 mL of differentiation medium at 37 °C with 5% CO2 in a humidified incubator.
Every 2 days, collect the solution and replace it with 2 mL of fresh medium.
Freeze collected release samples in liquid nitrogen and store at -20°C for further analyses.
Seed PC12 cells in 12-well collagen-coated plates as instructed.
After 24 hours, introduce release samples from representative time points to different wells.
For control wells, add fresh murine β-NGF (50 ng/mL).
After another 24 hours, image the cells using a light microscope.
Manually count neurite-bearing cells out of the total number of cells in the images for each well.
Plot a graph showing the percentage of PC12 cells with neurite outgrowth over time.
Acquire phase images of cultured PC12 cells up to 3 days after treatment with NGF.
Convert the image file to an 8-bit format.
Measure pixel to micrometer ratio using the image scale bar.
Set the scale using the Analyze | Set Scale command.
Measure the length of each neurite.
Manually count the number of branching points and the number of neurites originating from each cell soma.
